title: Union of India v. Madras Bar Association

content.caseIdentity: Union of India v. Madras Bar Association, (2010) 11 SCC 1
content.facts: The Court examined tribunalisation in company-law adjudication.
questionsBeforeCourt: What safeguards must accompany specialised adjudication?
What institutional features are constitutionally necessary?
What institutional safeguards are required for constitutionally valid tribunals?
content.ratioDecidendi: Specialisation cannot justify diminished independence or adjudicatory standards.
content.holding: The Court required constitutionally adequate institutional safeguards.
content.relevance: Use for the advantages and limits of tribunalisation.
